findings.evidence: Definition at TransitionCount.lean:79-80; every in-file proof unfolds it via `simp only [transitionCount]` (lines 85, 94, 104, 256). The repo idiom is an exported defining equation with the body kept hidden: `visitCount_def` at Combinatorics/Enumerative/SuccessorArray.lean:122-125 (comment at line 117: "These private witnesses let the exported equations keep the definition bodies unexposed"), and `occCount_def := (rfl)` at Data/Fintype/Fiber.lean:44-45.
findings.fix: Add `theorem transitionCount_def {n : ℕ} (w : Fin (n + 1) → α) (a b : α) : transitionCount w a b = occCount (fun i : Fin n => (w i.castSucc, w i.succ)) (a, b) := (rfl)` and use it in place of `simp only [transitionCount]` in this file.
findings.issue: transitionCount is now defined as an occCount of pairs, but no public equation states that. Its body is unexposed (no @[expose]), so outside this file the only characterization is transitionCount_eq_card_filter, which needs [DecidableEq α]; none of the new Function.occCount lemmas (occCount_pos, sum_occCount_eq_card, prod_occCount_pow, ...) can be applied to transitionCount.

findings.evidence: Data/Fintype/Fiber.lean:89-93; its statement `occCount f y = Nat.card (f ⁻¹' {y})` mentions only occCount plus Mathlib types, and Mathlib's matching lemma is `Nat.card_preimage_of_injective` at mathlib/Mathlib/SetTheory/Cardinal/Finite.lean:173.
findings.fix: Drop `private` and list it under Main results.
findings.issue: occCount_eq_card_preimage is private, but it is a standalone characteristic restatement of occCount (the set-preimage/fiber form, parallel to the public occCount_def and occCount_eq_card_filter), not a step specific to one argument. Consumers wanting Mathlib's preimage-cardinality API (Nat.card_preimage_of_injective, Set.Finite.preimage, ...) must re-derive it.

findings.evidence: Docstring lines 22-28 vs. declarations at lines 120-128 (prod_occCount_pow, @[to_additive]) and 140-150; both splitting lemmas are opened by consumers, e.g. `open Function (occCount occCount_eq_sum occCount_castSucc occCount_succ)` at Combinatorics/Enumerative/SuccessorArray.lean:73.
findings.fix: List `Function.prod_occCount_pow` (noting its additive form `sum_occCount_nsmul`) and the two `occCount_castSucc` / `occCount_succ` splitting lemmas in Main results.
findings.issue: The Main results list advertises `sum_occCount_nsmul`, which only exists as the to_additive-generated name, while the theorem actually written, `prod_occCount_pow`, and the two exported Fin splitting lemmas `occCount_castSucc` / `occCount_succ` (both used by consumers in this PR) are absent from the list.

summary: The new Function.occCount surface is minimal, body-unexposed and well annotated, but transitionCount is redefined in terms of occCount without exporting that equation, so downstream code cannot reach any of the new general lemmas; the preimage restatement is also needlessly private.
